intended_object: This is the canonical split monomorphism N(X; R) → C(X; R). The source is the normalized chain complex of a simplicial set X with coefficients in R, whose n-chains are a coproduct of copies of R indexed by the nondegenerate n-simplices. The target is the unnormalized (alternating face map) chain complex of X with coefficients in R. I inferred this from the docstring and the module documentation.
